card.name: Digits in Bible verse references
card.fires_on: A digit in a chapter number inside a Bible citation, such as Acts 1<<6>>:30 or 2 Sam. <<7>>:1. It also fires on the first digits of page or time numbers.

modes.label: Bible chapter digit
modes.description: A digit in the chapter number of a scripture reference in parentheses, just before the colon and verse.

modes.label: Other numbers before a colon or dash
modes.description: A digit in journal page ranges or clock times.

card.plain: It fires on the chapter number in a Bible reference, just before the verse.
